label: Exceeded god: a composite god with a uniting cause more in being, so God is not simple there
paraphrase: Closed control on one two-member interpretation (one member is God and composite; the other is not God, is more in esse than it and causes its esse; both are in act in esse): the exceeded-god rival holds; every composite has a distinct cause of its esse; whatever causes a quality in another is more such than it; and it is false that whatever is God is not composite. A statement about this interpretation only.
